title: orders.order-cancelled.v1
description: A confirmed order was cancelled. Cancelling the order does not cancel its garments, and this payload says so by omission: the command does not touch a single garment job, so naming them here would state something the transition did not do. A consumer that needs to know where each garment stands asks IOrderSnapshotQuery; a garment cancelled in its own right has orders.job-cancelled.v1. Only the configured code travels — the free-text cancellation reason is what a member of staff typed about a named person's order, which conventions.md section 5.5 does not admit and which the erasure workflow has to be able to redact. Neither the actor nor the approval travels (audit, ARCH-008, is the authority on who), and neither do the prohibited states the command was checked against: they are the application's input to the decision and not a fact about the order.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the cancellation was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The order, so the cancellation is ordered after everything else about it.

organisationId.description: The organisation the order belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch the order was taken at.

customerId.description: The customer the order was for. An identifier and nothing more.

orderNumber.description: The human reference, so a message about the cancellation can name the order.

reasonCode.description: The configured cancellation reason, by its code. Never null and never blank — the command refuses a cancellation without one — and deliberately not constrained to a fixed set: the vocabulary is branch configuration, reviewed under open decision OD-10 in docs/prd/assumptions-and-open-decisions.md and seeded by issue #34, not an enumeration this contract may freeze. The value in the example file is a placeholder, not a code this system issues, and a subscriber that hard-codes it has hard-coded nothing. Never free text.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
